entry.name: jit.geom.displace
entry.digest: Displaces a surface using a height field
entry.description: jit.geom.displace displaces surface geometry based on a height field geometry matrix that can be sampled in different ways. The height field matrix is provided via the secondary inlet.

attributes.name: sampler
attributes.digest: How to sample height field matrix
attributes.description: Describes how to sample the height field matrix. The default is "nearest".

choices.label: Uses the nearest neighbor when sampling the height field matrix.
Takes an interpolated value from the texture coordinate's neighboring texels in the height field matrix.

attributes.name: strength
attributes.digest: Displacement strength
attributes.description: The strength of the displacement. The final displacement is calculated by offseting byand then scaling by this value. A negative strength can be used to invert the displacement.

attributes.name: tex_coord_mode
attributes.digest: What texture coordinates should be used for sampling
attributes.description: Describes where the texture coordinates used to sample the height field should come from. The default is "auto".

choices.digest: Automatically determine what texture coordinates to use
choices.label: If the surface geometry has texture coordinates, they will be used. Otherwise,will be used.

choices.digest: Use position to generate texture coordinates
choices.label: The object will generate texture coordinates based on the positions relative to the object bounding box.
